events.reason: Aegis 2.0.0 packaging defect (FSharp.Core >= 11.0.101) breaks App.slnx restore with NU1605 on SDK 10.0.402; release-selection gate (VER-001-O1, VER-003-O3) requires an owner re-selection of aegis in the governed dependency lock. Waiting for Aegis 2.0.1.
Owner decision: causa's governed competition lock (Indy-init dependency-lock.json, echelon-current 1.37.0) selects Aegis 1.0.0

echelon-current 1.42.0: conditor upgrade --current refuses forma-workflow 1.2.0 (not selected by the 1.42.0 Registry authority). Dropping it from conditor.json needs conditor init to re-lock, which the session's permission classifier refused on this governed repository. Also needs a successor governed dependency lock in Indy-init (owner decision; toolchain.lock.json is an owner pin) and a new stack-drift evidence run. The Forma 1.0.1 codemod was dry-run (653 lines in 25 files; Folio ef-print-* names must be kept).
